features.description: Change audit envelope filename pattern to include feature_id, eliminating within-plan multi-feature collision. New pattern (in audit_writer.write): `{agent}-{role}-{feature_id}-i{n}.json`. Old pattern was `{agent}-{role}-i{n}.json` (set in F005a-1 of 2026-04-19-001). The change is single-callsite in audit_writer.write — `feature_id` is threaded as a new keyword argument from supervisor.dispatch_volley (which already knows the feature_id of the current volley). build_audit is unchanged; the audit dict shape is unchanged (feature_id is encoded in the filename only, not added as a new audit field — D006-style schema discipline). Forward-only: existing envelope files at the old pattern remain on disk and remain readable. The only readers that traverse audit/ paths are the supervisor's circuit-breaker helpers (check_diminishing_returns, check_convergence_collapse) and the prior-auditor reader in prompts._findings_block — all of which receive explicit Path arguments accumulated during dispatch (audit_paths: list[Path] in supervisor.VolleyResult), not filename globs. So the change does not break any reader. The originating-context for this plan: plan 2026-05-01-005-feat-target-context-platform-fix's F002 confirmation volley overwrote F001's i0+i1 envelopes in working tree (mitigated by manual copy to evidence/f002/audit-original-volley/ before F002 dispatched). D013 of plan 005 records the deferral.
steps: Modify `scripts/jarvis_orchestrate/audit_writer.py`: add `feature_id: str` keyword argument to `write(audit, plan_dir, *, feature_id)` (positional callers updated). Validate `feature_id` matches `^F\d{3}$` (the regex used by `agent-conventions/schemas/v1.0/features.schema.json` for feature ids). Reject `None`, empty, or non-matching strings with `ValueError` BEFORE creating audit_dir or writing bytes. Filename construction line becomes `f"{audit['agent']}-{audit['agent_role']}-{feature_id}-i{iteration}.json"`. Module docstring + transcript.py docstring updated to reference new pattern.

Update `scripts/jarvis_orchestrate/supervisor.py`: BOTH audit-writing dispatch paths gain `feature_id=feature_id` on the `audit_writer.write(audit, loaded.plan_dir)` calls — `dispatch_single_agent` (line 595) AND `dispatch_volley`'s persist points (line 1342). The variable is already in scope at every callsite as the dispatched feature.

Search the codebase for any other `audit_writer.write` callers (cli.py dispatch-from-plan, single-agent dispatch path, any test harness) and thread feature_id through. Audit:
  $ grep -rn 'audit_writer.write\|audit_writer\.write' scripts/ --include='*.py'

Add new test `scripts/jarvis_orchestrate/tests/test_audit_filename_feature_id.py` covering: (a) F001 + F002 within same plan dir produce non-colliding filenames; (b) old-pattern envelope file remains readable when a caller already holds a Path to it (no implicit glob in any reader); (c) iterations within a single feature still increment correctly (`{agent}-{role}-{feature_id}-i0.json`, `-i1.json`); (d) **negative cases** — `feature_id=None`, `feature_id=''`, `feature_id='F1'` (too short), `feature_id='feat-1'`, `feature_id='F001/../escape'` (path-traversal attempt) all raise `ValueError` AND leave the audit/ dir empty (no partial artifact); (e) BOTH dispatch paths (`dispatch_single_agent` + `dispatch_volley`) write filenames with the feature_id component when invoked end-to-end with scripted executors.

Update existing F002 tests (test_audit_writer_normalize.py, test_audit_writer_f002_supervisor_integration.py) to pass feature_id where they invoke audit_writer.write directly, AND update any path-construction expectations from the old pattern to the new pattern when those tests dispatch through the writer (NOT when they read pre-existing F001 fixtures, which stay at fixture-style names).

Place originating-context evidence under `evidence/finding/` — copy the relevant snippets (D013 from plan 005 decisions.jsonl, the gate-state.json + working-tree audit/ listing showing the collision) into this plan's evidence dir. Do NOT edit plan 005 history.
features.acceptance: (1) `audit_writer.write(audit, plan_dir, *, feature_id)` constructs the persisted filename as `{agent}-{role}-{feature_id}-i{n}.json`. The `feature_id` kwarg is required (no default) and is validated against `^F\d{3}$` (the regex used by `agent-conventions/schemas/v1.0/features.schema.json`). Validation happens BEFORE any disk I/O — invalid input raises `ValueError` and no file lands. Signature change is backwards-incompatible for in-tree callers (which are all updated in this commit) but irrelevant for external consumers since audit_writer is platform-internal. (2) **Both production audit-writing dispatch paths thread feature_id**: `supervisor.dispatch_volley` (the per-iteration persist points around line 1342) AND `supervisor.dispatch_single_agent` (the single-shot persist around line 595) pass `feature_id=feature_id` (already in scope as the dispatched feature). Verified by (a) grep test asserting both callsites carry the kwarg; (b) end-to-end test that exercises both paths with scripted executors and asserts the persisted filenames carry the feature_id component. No other in-tree code path writes audit envelopes; the only test-harness callsites (test_ec5_classifier._post_inject, test_audit_writer_normalize._load_fixture call paths) are updated to pass feature_id too. (3) **Collision-free proof**: a synthetic test dispatches two volleys against the same plan dir, one with feature_id='F001' and one with feature_id='F002'. After both complete, the audit/ directory contains BOTH features' envelopes (≥4 files: claude-implementer-F001-i0.json, codex-auditor-F001-i0.json, claude-implementer-F002-i0.json, codex-auditor-F002-i0.json), none overwritten. Verified by `sorted(audit_dir.iterdir())` listing assertion. (4) **Old-pattern readability proof**: a test copies a real historical envelope from plan 2026-05-01-005's committed audit/ (e.g., `claude-implementer-i0.json` at HEAD `836c71d`) into a tmp_path and exercises the supervisor read paths (`circuit_breakers.check_diminishing_returns([copy_path])`, `circuit_breakers.check_convergence_collapse([copy_path])`, `prompts._findings_block(copy_path)`). All return without error and consume the file's contents normally. Asserts that the old filename does not need to be renamed for the platform to keep functioning. (5) **No filename-pattern globs in readers**: a structural test greps `scripts/jarvis_orchestrate/` for `glob`, `rglob`, `iterdir`, and `re.compile` patterns matching `-i\d+\.json` style filename heuristics. None should be present that would discriminate against the new pattern. If any are added in future, they must be updated to accept both patterns. (6) Iteration sequencing within a single feature still works: F001's i0 and i1 within the same plan dir produce `claude-implementer-F001-i0.json` and `claude-implementer-F001-i1.json` (no collision between iterations of the same feature). (7) **No historical file rename / no migration script**: the implementation must not contain any code that walks `docs/plans/*/audit/` to rename existing files. Auditor verifies by reading the diff. (8) **No schema change**: `audit.schema.json` is unmodified. The `feature_id` field is encoded in the filename only, not added as a new top-level audit dict property. The audit's existing `audit_id` field (`{plan_id}#{agent}#{iteration}`) is unchanged — feature_id is a writer-side filesystem concern, not a payload-side concern. **Payload-identity scope (D001)**: two features within the same plan can still produce envelopes with identical `audit_id` strings (e.g., `2026-05-02-002#claude#0` for both F001 and F002 round 0). This is acceptable because filename uniqueness is what F001 fixes; payload-identity expansion is deferred unless a downstream consumer needs it. (9) **Negative-input proof**: `audit_writer.write` with `feature_id=None`, `feature_id=''`, `feature_id='F1'` (too short), `feature_id='feat-1'`, or `feature_id='F001/../escape'` (path traversal) raises `ValueError` BEFORE creating audit_dir or writing bytes. Verified by parametrized test asserting (a) `ValueError` raised, (b) `audit_dir.exists() == False` post-raise (no-partial-artifact, mirrors F002 acceptance #5 from plan 005). (10) Plan 005's committed audit envelopes are NOT touched. Originating-context evidence lives under this plan's `evidence/finding/` (a copy, not a reference into plan 005). (11) `audit_writer.write` docstring + module docstring updated to document the new pattern AND the validation regex; `transcript.py` docstring updated to reference new pattern in its 'Authoritative state lives in...' line. (12) All existing orchestrate test modules stay green after the test updates in step 5.

evidence_refs.note: audit_writer.write(audit, plan_dir, *, feature_id) — required kwarg, validated against `^F\d{3}$` (single source of truth with agent-conventions/schemas/v1.0/features.schema.json $defs.feature.properties.id.pattern). Validation raises ValueError BEFORE any disk I/O — no audit_dir.mkdir, no write_text on invalid input. Filename: `{agent}-{role}-{feature_id}-i{n}.json`.

Both production audit-writing callsites pass feature_id: dispatch_single_agent (line 595, feature_id=feature_id) and dispatch_volley's per-iteration persist (line 1342, feature_id=feature["id"]). No other production audit_writer.write callers.

22 tests: filename includes feature_id, iteration sequencing within feature, collision-free F001+F002 in same plan dir, parametrized negative cases (None/empty/F1/F0001/feat-1/f001/G001/path-traversal/NUL/whitespace), regex matches schema $defs.feature, old-pattern envelope readability via circuit_breakers.check_* + prompts._findings_block, structural no-glob proof on consumer modules, dispatch_volley + dispatch_single_agent end-to-end via scripted executors, two-feature volley collision-free.

F001 close-out memo — direct path rationale: small, mechanical writer/callsite/test change with locked acceptance; plan 005 demonstrated diminishing returns on tiny platform patches with adversarial review.
D003 records F001 close-out + direct-path decision (no volley). D001 + D002 already document payload-identity-deferral and feature_id boundary-validation rationale.
Final state: 22/22 F001 targeted tests pass, 469 + 6 skipped full orchestrate suite (was 447 → +22), ruff clean, sanitization clean (551 files).
